highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.4 corrects GPU glyph and stencil tracking and removes a Windows HarfBuzz compliance blocker.

bullets.detail: Prevents partial glyph-atlas updates from treating evicted glyphs as current, and tracks shared stencil clears correctly across differing surface origins.

Removes command-line truncation-warning suppression from libHarfBuzzSharp so dependent applications no longer need a BinSkim BA2007 baseline for that DLL. Other reported BinSkim warnings are unchanged.

harfbuzz_summary: The Windows native DLL now passes BinSkim BA2007 without changing its exported ABI or the bundled HarfBuzz version. Other existing BinSkim warnings are unchanged.

v4.150.4.headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.4 corrects GPU glyph and stencil tracking and removes a Windows HarfBuzz compliance blocker.
